expectations.text: KRBTGT account credential changes now at least every six months (ISM-1847, was annual)
expectations.evidence: No ISM-1847/KRBTGT change mentioned; KRBTGT never appears

expectations.text: DCSync-permission account reviews now at least every six months (ISM-1934, was annual)
expectations.evidence: No ISM-1934/DCSync change mentioned; only generic "quarterly or annual" access recertification

expectations.text: Post-deployment vulnerability assessments/penetration tests now at least every six months (ISM-2118, was annual)
expectations.evidence: Pen testing described as "often annual" — omits (and effectively contradicts) the new 6-monthly ISM-2118 requirement

expectations.text: Service provider access restricted to explicitly approved remote management tools, source addresses and time windows (ISM-2124), with organisation-controlled logging the provider cannot modify or delete (ISM-2125)
expectations.evidence: Mentions JIT/time-boxed access and customer-retained logging as expected "direction of travel," but not the actual ISM-2124/2125 requirements (approved tools/source addresses/time windows; provider-unmodifiable organisation-controlled logging)

expectations.text: Unauthorised service-provider access or administration is to be treated as a cyber security incident (ISM-1576 amendment)
expectations.evidence: No statement that unauthorised service-provider access is to be treated as a cyber security incident (ISM-1576 amendment); only contractual incident-notification clauses
